body: Under SEBI LODR (Reg 46 amendment May 2021; Reg 30/Schedule III amendment June 2023), listed companies must place earnings-call transcripts on their website and file them with the exchanges within 5 working days. Audio/video recordings must also be disclosed promptly (the 2023 text says before the next trading day or within 24 hours; secondary sources differ on the exact window, so re-check the consolidated regulation). In practice transcripts appear as exchange announcements. On NSE the category is 'Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates' with attchmntText containing 'Transcript' (KPITTECH had 17 transcript filings in its announcement history). On BSE, NEWSSUB reads 'Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript'. screener.in company pages show a Concalls section WITHOUT login, with Transcript links (BSE AnnPdfOpen), PPT links and REC links (company-hosted mp3); AI Summary and notes need login. PDFs download directly. Poppler pdftotext -layout is installed and turned the 20-page KPIT Q2FY27 transcript into 8,530 words of clean, speaker-labelled text. Scanned PDFs (common in micro caps) need OCR. Company IR sites duplicate the files but are inconsistent, so the exchange is the canonical source.
title: Where Indian concall transcripts live and how to extract them
